Name: Harrold Hardyng
Quirks: speaks with the easy confidence of a young man who knows he is the heir
is more likeable in person than his reputation suggests - the arrogance is somewhat performative
is aware his future depends on Robin Arryn's health without quite acknowledging how uncomfortable that awareness is
CharacterDescription: Harrold Hardyng called Harry the Heir is the nephew of Lady Lysa Arryn and through her the heir to the Vale if young Robin Arryn dies without issue - which given Robin's fragile health is not unlikely. He is in his early twenties, handsome, aware of his position, and somewhat overconfident about what it makes him. He has a bastard daughter Alys. He is the sort of young man who has been told he is important his entire life without being tested by it yet.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Harrold Hardyng, often called Harry the Heir and sometimes the Young Falcon, is a gallant, handsome squire, and a ward of Lady Anya Waynwood. He is the cousin and heir presumptive of Lord Robert Arryn and would ascend to rule of the Vale as 'Harrold Arryn' should Lord Robert die without issue. He has recently had a few scandals at court involving serving girls and merchant's daughters.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: In the Vale two days before Ned Stark's execution. Robin Arryn is sickly. Harry is the heir.
